defect: closed_trades_cumulative exceeds trades_total (both affected fleet slots, first paired dispatch)

deterministic_reproduction_real_route.harness: _load_env_plugin('gym_fx_env') + shared_execution_envelope, synthetic 26-bar CSV where every bar from 8 pierces the 5% stop intrabar; four long entries, each settles ON its entry bar
deterministic_reproduction_real_route.refusal: TraceReconciliationError: trace running counter 3 exceeds the summary trades_total 2 — incoherent accounting

root_cause: SUMMARY CONSTRUCTION / dual stream: the trace counter comes from bridge.trade_count (incremented by bt notify_trade closes AND by the envelope's _settle_position direct broker accounting), while summary trades_total comes from backtrader's TradeAnalyzer (total.total). An entry-bar direct settlement zeroes the broker position via position.update() WITHOUT a bt order, so backtrader's Trade object stays logically open and the analyzer undercounts subsequent cycles; the two streams diverge exactly when the envelope settles on the entry bar — which is why 2-epoch CPU dry-runs (policy never at 3xATR) stayed coherent and both affected fleet slots (trained policies) refused

candidates_excluded.rejected_superseded_orders: rejections are counted in diagnostics, not in bridge.trade_count
